title: The Autonomous region in the hills
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：autonomous　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 autonomous 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the director wrote of ① an autonomous region in the hills in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② more autonomous than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the autonomous ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most autonomous region in the hills anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1964 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too autonomous to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the autonomous ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an autonomous decision of their own, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as autonomous as the decision of their own they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was autonomous or not, and he said so.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something autonomous, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite autonomous; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the autonomous ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980, twice over, she wrote of another autonomous region in the hills in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed  more autonomous than anybody had expected.  The most autonomous decision of their own in the whole theatre, she said in 1982, was the one she could never quite name; the autonomous ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 自治（前置定语 an autonomous region in the hills：1970 年导演在戏报里记下的那件自治的地方）
B. adj. 自治／自主（比较级 more autonomous than：文中两处，一处比山里的地方，一处比预想）
C. adj. 自治／自主（最高级 the most autonomous：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 自治（表语 too autonomous to do：母亲觉得它太自治，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 自主（前置定语 an autonomous decision of their own：叔叔把整件事称作一桩自主的决定）
F. adj. 自主（同级比较 as autonomous as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩自主的决定相比）
G. adj. 自主（后置定语 something autonomous：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 自主（受程度副词修饰 quite autonomous：那位演员的评价）

items.q: an autonomous region in the hills
the most autonomous region in the hills anybody
an autonomous decision of their own

answers.why: autonomous 意为“自治”，1970 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件自治的地方”，此处作前置定语 an autonomous region in the hills。
autonomous 意为“自治”，此处用比较级 more autonomous than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
autonomous 意为“自治”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最自治的一件，故用最高级 the most autonomous region in the hills。
autonomous 意为“自治”，母亲认为这件东西“太自治了，谁也用不上”，too autonomous to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
autonomous 意为“自主”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩自主的决定”，此处作前置定语 an autonomous decision of their own。
autonomous 意为“自主”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩自主的决定一样自主”，同级比较用 as autonomous as。
autonomous 意为“自主”，戏报上那半行字要的是“自主的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something autonomous。
autonomous 意为“自主”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当自主”，quite 修饰原级 autonomous。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件自治的地方。（an autonomous region in the hills）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更自治。（more autonomous than …）
母亲觉得它太自治，谁也用不上。（too autonomous to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩自主的决定。（an autonomous decision of their own）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩自主的决定一样自主。（as autonomous as …）
到了 1977 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件自主的东西。（something autonomous）
answers: In 1970 the director wrote of an autonomous region in the hills in the poster.
Everybody said it was more autonomous than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too autonomous to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an autonomous decision of their own.
He said nobody would call it as autonomous as the decision of their own they had once had.
By 1977 the poster asked for nothing but something autonomous.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 autonomous 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the director wrote of an autonomous region in the hills in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most autonomous region in the hills in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too autonomous to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an autonomous decision of their own, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite autonomous, and everybody laughed.
The autonomous ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
